title: My Blue Heaven | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Private Pool Steps From Beach Access- My Blue Heaven By Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: My Blue Heaven by Royal Destinations Location: Water's Edge at Seacrest Beach Address: 241 Geoff Wilder Lane Details: Relax and enjoy the abundant Gulf views from the seven balconies throughout this 3,200 square foot luxurious, home. My Blue Heaven is located in the gated community of Water’s Edge, on the Gulf side of Scenic 30A. This home is perfect for entertaining and making memories with family and friends. Enjoy the large private pool or take a stroll down the private pine tree leading to the beach. My Blue Heaven is one of the largest homes in Water's Edge and just 150 yards to the private beach access. Outside of the Water's Edge gate, on 30A, is Timpoochee Trail, a 19-mile paved pedestrian/bike path running along Scenic Highway 30A from Dune Allen Beach to Rosemary Beach. You’re also a short bike ride or walk to Seacrest and Rosemary Beach for unique boutiques and dining. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Private Beach Access: 150 Yards -Parking Spaces: 2 in Driveway -Gated Community -Dining Accommodations: Table for 6 and Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available -Natural Gas Grill -Foosball Table -Private Heated Pool: 15’ x 16’ -Available For Winter Monthly Rentals- Contact our team with any questions regarding pricing for monthly winter rentals. *Pool Heat is available for an additional $280 (pre-tax). *The pool heater requires 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 13 5 Beds / 5.5 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Kitchen / Dining Area / Living Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 4 (Bunk Room): (1) Twin/Twin Bunk and (1) Twin/Full Bunk -Full Bathroom (Shower/Tub Combo) -Laundry Room Third Floor: -Bedroom 5: King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes -1 Beach Service Set* *Seasonal: March – November Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
